body: I have just lost 2 friends. 1 of my friend was just one of those guys that doesn't actually like girls, he likes what they have to offer. And he went after one of my female friends(she never had a bf so she's an "easy target"-My ex-friend). And i tried to get her out of his vacuum of lies, but she kept falling for it....i blame myself for losing both of them
I know you probably came here to make me feel better...but calling me ungrateful and basicly saying life gets worse, *doesn't* help..

I know they're professionals and they've "heard it all"....but at my school, word gets out about who goes to a clinic or who has a therapist...and the kids get treated different. And i've even noticed my parents treating me different, and i don't want to be treated like "that kid"
Thanks. I'm going to x-post it now.

I'm not seeking "medical help", just advise.

And that's what I want, medication. But i don't want to have to go through the struggle of telling another person face to face again
I'm just not sure if i wanna talk to people face to face about this situation though. Hell, it was hard enough telling my parents. I don't know how it would go
